sn22.59:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi ||
sn22.59:2.2: rūpañ ca bhikkhave attā abhavissa nayidaṃ rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya labbhetha ca rūpe
sn22.59:2.3: Evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā aho sīti || || 4
sn22.59:2.4: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave rūpam anattā tasmā rūpam ābādhāya saṃvattati || na ca labbhati rūpe
sn22.59:2.5: Evam me rūpaṃ hotu evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosīti || || 5
sn22.59:3.2: vedanā ca hidam bhikkhave attā abhavissa na yidaṃ vedanā ābādhāya saṃvatteyya || labbhetha ca vedanāya
sn22.59:3.3: Evaṃ me vedanā hotu evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosīti || || 6
sn22.59:3.4: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave vedanā anattā tasmā vedanā ābādhāya saṃvattati || na ca labbhati vedanāya
sn22.59:3.5: Evam me vedanā hotu evam me vedanā mā ahosīti || || 7
sn22.59:4.3: saṅkhārā ca hidam bhikkhave attā abhavissaṃsu || na yidaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ || labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu
sn22.59:4.4: Evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesunti || 9
sn22.59:4.5: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave saṅkhārā anattā tasmā saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvattanti || na ca labbhati saṅkhāresu
sn22.59:4.6: Evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesunti || || 10
sn22.59:5.2: viññāṇaṃ hidam bhikkhave attā abhivissa na yidaṃ viññāṇam ābādhāya saṃvatteyya || labbhetha ca viññāṇe
sn22.59:5.3: Evam me viññāṇaṃ hotu evam me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosīti || || 11
sn22.59:5.4: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave viññāṇam anattā tasmā viññāṇam ābādhaya saṃvattati || na ca labbhati viññāṇe
sn22.59:5.5: Evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosīti || || 12
sn22.59:6.4: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.59:6.6: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkham vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.59:6.7: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || ||
sn22.59:6.12: Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti ||
sn22.59:6.14: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.59:6.16: Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.59:6.17: Etaṃ mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || ||
sn22.59:7.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannam ajjhattam vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā panītaṃ vā || yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na me so attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammāppaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || 18
sn22.59:10.1: Yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā panītaṃ vā || yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 22
sn22.59:11.1: Evam passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃ nibbindati || vedanāya nibbindati || saññāya || saṅkhāresu || viññāṇasmim nibbindati || ||
sn22.59:11.2: Nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn22.59:11.3: Khīnā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || 23
sn22.59:12.2: attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanduṃ || ||
sn22.59:12.3: imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne pañcavaggiyānam bhikkhūnam anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsū
